messages:
alex: Heads up — PR #4620 (ui/render: improve glyph cache) is stuck in the merge queue because macos-render tests reported a snapshot diff on macos-retina. Do we want to update the snapshot or do a targeted rerun? I don't want to block the merge window.
maria: pinging @jamal and @sasha who own the render suite. any quick read on whether this is a real regression or a flaky antialias issue?
jamal: saw the failure. quick glance suggests a tiny antialias/subpixel shift — looks nondet, possibly GPU driver or seed related.
sasha: agreed — if it's subpixel noise we should rerun targeted first. we have a targeted rerun job: `ci-targeted --pr 4620 --shard macos-render-retina`.
alex: can you rerun only the failed shard? prefer not to spin the whole matrix.
ci-bot: Buildkite: queued targeted rerun for PR 4620 shards: macos-render-retina-1. Job id: bk-9087. Queued at 2024-06-12T10:22:00Z.
jamal: while that runs, can you paste the failing diff so we can sanity-check whether it's acceptable if it happens again?
alex: here's the failing snippet:
```diff
- expected: "glyph-layer-blob-123"
+ actual:   "glyph-layer-blob-124"
```
small byte-level shift in raster output, looks like subpixel offset. no semantic changes.
oliver: quick Q — did this PR change font stacks or hinting? that would explain a deterministic shift.
alex: no font changes, just a cache refactor that touches ordering.
sasha: bk-9087 finished ✅ — rerun passed on retina shard. Given that, this seems transient. I recommend not updating snapshots and proceeding with merge. tagging as flaky/transient. @maria can you approve so we don't miss the window?
maria: LGTM. :thumbsup: I'll approve and queue the merge. Alex, add a note in the PR description about the transient macOS render flicker so QA can watch for recurrence.
alex: done — added a one-liner and linked this thread. merge window cutoff?
maria: cutoff in ~1.5h. approving now and queuing merge. @ci-bot please merge on green.
ci-bot: Merge queued. Will merge once required checks are green.
